successors.name: Indus Valley Civilisation
successors.text: the Kachi Plain of Balochistan, "between the modern-day Pakistani cities of Quetta, Kalat and Sibi", "near the Bolan Pass, to the west of the Indus River" (the gazetteer has no Mehrgarh yet)

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the farming villages of Mehrgarh hold the Kachi Plain of Balochistan (the earliest settlement "dated from 7000 BCE or 5250 BCE").
5500 BCE: the pottery-using Neolithic of Mehrgarh II-VI begins: the Indus page's table puts "Mehrgarh II-VI" (ceramic Neolithic) in the Regionalisation Era "5500-3300".
4000 BCE: the Chalcolithic Togau phase begins at Mehrgarh: "The Togau phase... c.
3500 BCE: Mehrgarh Period IV begins: "Period IV 3500-3250 BCE".
3300 BCE: the Kachi Plain enters the Indus tradition: the Early Harappan Ravi phase begins c.

certainty.note: Known from one great site and its neighbours; no frontier is recorded.
